original_test_intent: Flash an explicitly supplied GPU firmware image through NVSM, activate it when required, and demonstrate that the approved target version persists while the GPU and host remain healthy.
original_method: Identify GPU UUID/BDF/model and current firmware; validate NVSM support, image signature/hash and model/version compatibility; preserve pre-state logs; confirm exact `-f` syntax, target scope, stable power, OOB and rollback; perform one approved flash, activate or reboot per vendor procedure; verify persisted version, enumeration, driver and error health.
manual_activity: GPU firmware owner supplies the exact signed image, target/version compatibility and recovery package; operator controls workload isolation, reboot window, redundant power and console access.
required_inputs: Signed GPU firmware image with immutable checksum
GPU UUID/BDF/model and current/target version map
Stable power, OOB console and maintenance authorization
safety_requirements: Do not infer image path, GPU target or firmware version
Reject bare global update and validate signature/hash
Keep redundant power and OOB through reboot
Stop on flash, enumeration, thermal, PCIe or driver anomaly; never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify image, target, command and recovery contract
Run one approved flash and required activation
Verify persistence and health after reboot

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its parameterized `-f` direction is safer than the bare source update, but it still depends on vendor-confirmed syntax and exact target behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the vendor-supported command with the approved immutable image and explicit allowlisted GPU target; correct `show firmwar` to `show firmware` only after confirming deployed syntax.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Local image selection, before/after version checks, firmware flash and activation verification remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the update to one signed image, one identified target and one recorded version transition, with controlled activation and tested recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves the invalid inventory command and adds target, artifact, reboot, health and rollback gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The generic container row does not substitute for this image-specific GPU flash path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incompatible or interrupted GPU flash can prevent device enumeration or require vendor recovery.

project_override_considerations: The GPU firmware authority must map image release to exact GPU model and decide whether NVSM selects a target implicitly or needs an explicit device scope.
expected_evidence: Complete flash output, exit status and activation/reboot timestamps
Post-reboot persisted version, enumeration, driver/DCGM/PCIe/thermal health
Rollback readiness or recovery record and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Turns an ambiguous bare flash into a traceable image-to-GPU version transition and explicitly records the source command defect.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware persistence must be checked after the activation boundary, not merely immediately after the update process exits. A meaningful result therefore couples the immutable image and target identity to pre/post versions, reboot survival, enumeration and health, with recovery ready before any write begins.
